title: Mahjong Gakuensai DX: Zenjitsu ni Matsuwaru Funsenki
native_title: 麻雀 学園祭ＤＸ ～前日にまつわる奮戦記～
overview:
"The day before the school festival..."

The familiar Gakuensai characters playing mahjong the day before the school festival?

Back on the Sega Saturn with a completely original story! Enjoy the record of their mahjong battles on the eve of the festival.

Mahjong Gakuensai DX is an adult mahjong game for one player. With the school festival only a day away, you sit down to play mahjong against the familiar Gakuensai cast, including Keiko Takahashi, Kyoka Kagiya and Mayu Sakaki. Win your matches to move the story along and unlock each character's special scenes.

- Original story set on the eve of the school festival
- Mahjong against the series' heroines
- Star voice cast and animated scenes
- For ages 18 and over

「学園祭の前日に…」

おなじみ学園祭のキャラクター達が学園祭前日に麻雀？

完全オリジナルストーリーでセガサターンに再登場！前日の麻雀奮戦記！楽しんでください。
